# Louiss Web Studio

> Web design and development studio based in Morocco, building custom websites
> for businesses in Morocco and international clients abroad.

## About

Louiss Web Studio designs and builds custom, conversion-focused websites.
Full-stack development using Next.js, Tailwind, Sanity CMS, and vanilla
HTML/CSS/JS, deployed on Vercel or Netlify. Design work done in Figma.

## Services

- Custom website design and development for small and medium businesses in Morocco
- Full-stack web development for direct clients abroad (multilingual sites,
  headless CMS, custom booking/e-commerce flows)
- Figma-to-code development for design agencies that need execution capacity
- Local SEO and Google Business Profile setup for Moroccan businesses

## Industries served

Restaurants, hospitality (riads, guesthouses), dental and medical clinics,
car rental agencies, real estate, e-commerce, travel and tourism.

## Notable projects

- Maison Monchef: multilingual (French/English/Arabic, RTL) real estate
  platform for a Dubai-based client, built with Next.js and Sanity CMS
- El Majdoub Immobilier: short-term rental platform in Agadir, Morocco
- Adventure Keys: travel and tourism booking website
- Kosmeticas: e-commerce design for a Moroccan perfumery
